Title: Agent Server Parameters
Question: How do I troubleshoot Agent Server Parameters (Classic Ui) in Adroit SCADA?
Answer:
Steps: Channels: this is the maximum number of possible Client-Server connections from the Agent Server to the outside world, such as to the User Interface, other Agent Servers, DDE links. The default setting is 20. - Remote Timeout: this is the time the system waits before reporting a lost connection between any two Agent Servers, or an Agent Server and the user interface. - Agent Path: this is typically the installation folder in which the Adroit executables and dynamic link libraries are stored. - Save WGP file on exit: check to ensure changes are saved at Agent Server shutdown.

Title: Account Policy
Question: What are the key specifications or limits for Account Policy (Classic Ui)?
Answer:
A locked account remains locked until an administrator unlocks it or a specified amount of time passes. Locked accounts cannot log on. The also determines whether or not a remote user will be forcibly disconnected from all connections to servers in the domain if that user's logon hours expire, and whether users must log on before changing their passwords. If lockout is enabled, then a user account becomes locked if there are a number of incorrect attempts to log on to that account, occurring with no more than a specified amount of time between any two of the bad logon attempts.

For example, an AgentGroup agent could contain all agents related to a specific section of a plant, or all agents required for a specific report. alarm the process of monitoring an agent for the occurrence of a specific abnormal condition or state (alarm type). alarm type a named (abnormal) condition or state of an agent that is defined by which of its status bits are simultaneously ON or OFF, which can also list the slots of this agent to report when this condition occurs. alarming strategy a set of guidelines or a plan to optimise the configuration of the alarming of agents. Once created it can easily be transferred and adapted for other projects, as required. aspect ratio a ratio or comparison of its width to its height. Title: How to use Wanlink
Question: How do I configure use Wanlink (Classic Ui) in Adroit SCADA?
Answer:
The Configuration file of each WanClient , must essentially specify how to communicate to the WanServer and which local tags in these remote Agent Servers (AS3), (AS4) need to be "linked" to tags that reside in the primary Agent Server (AS1) and the communication settings to its WanServer connected to the primary Agent Server (AS1). The WanServer will then establish connection to the primary computer's Agent Server (AS1) and communication based on this configuration will commence from then on.

This change ALSO prevents the use of remote desktop for perform maintenance especially on stand-alone (no remote connection licences) installations. Title: Issues related to using Remote Desktop to Run Adroit
Topic: Problems running the Agent Server
Question: How do I use Problems running the Agent Server (Classic Ui) in Adroit SCADA?
Answer:
You cannot start the Agent Server as an application by using the Windows Remote Desktop (a terminal client). This is because Windows does not support USB ports when you use the Remote Desktop application, so any USB HASP is effectively invisible to the Agent Server. Note: This is not a problem when starting the Agent Server as a service from within a Remote Desktop.

Title: Main.csv
Question: What are the key specifications or limits for Main.csv (Classic Ui)?
Answer:
- Retries: This stores the number of times that communications are to be reattempted when the communications to this WanServer fail. - Ping Period: This stores the period in seconds to wait after the communications to this WanServer fail before the WanClient will retry to establish communications. - Connect Timeout: This is not being used. - Transaction Timeout: This stores the time in seconds before a requested transaction made to the server fails. - Server Database: This stores the name of the CSV file, that is also stored in the database folder .

Title: Manually Edit Groups
Topic: To manually edit groups:
Question: What are the key specifications or limits for To manually edit groups: (Classic Ui)?
Answer:
Groups are stored in the user-specified database filename of their applicable Server, specified when adding a server . This .CSV file is located within the database folder and contains all the specific configuration of the tag groups and their tag links that have been configured within the specific server. The default value of 0 implies "as fast as possible" and the rate will depend on the total number of configured groups. - Buffer size: This is not being used. - Group Type: This stores the communication type required by the tag links within the group.

Title: Reversing Input Slot Order
Question: How do I use Reversing Input Slot Order (Classic Ui) in Adroit SCADA?
Answer:
It may be necessary, due to external constraints, to read the 16 bit input rawValue into the 16 Boolean input slots V01-V16 in reverse order, so that V01 becomes the Least Significant Bit of the rawValue .slot. To reverse input slots order (v1 to v16) within the MultiState agent . This can be achieved by making the Registry Key ReverseMultiStateBits FALSE (i.e. set to 0) for WG.INI.

Title: Trust Relationships
Question: What are the key specifications or limits for Trust Relationships (Classic Ui)?
Answer:
in Windows specify the domains that this domain trusts, and the domains that are allowed to trust this domain. A trust relationship is a link between two domains, where one domain honors the users of another domain, trusting that other domain to authenticate the logons of its own users. When are properly established between the domains of a network, they allow a user to have only one user account in one domain, yet to access the entire network.

Title: Audit Policy
Question: What are the key specifications or limits for Audit Policy (Classic Ui)?
Answer:
Windows can track selected activities of users, by auditing security events and then placing entries in a computer's security log. Windows can record a range of security event types, from a system-wide event such as a user logging on, to an attempt by a user to read a specific file. Both successful and unsuccessful attempts to perform an action can be recorded. When administering a Windows computer that is not a domain controller, this policy affects only the security log of that computer.

Title: To Disable the Task Manager for the Current User
Topic: Disabling the Task Manager for the Current User
Question: How do I configure Disabling the Task Manager for the Current User (Classic Ui) in Adroit SCADA?
Answer:
PLEASE NOTE: When working on a 64 bit operating system, remember to add "\Wow6432Node" to the path of each registry setting after "\SOFTWARE", for instance: "HKEY_LOCAL_MACHINE\SOFTWARE\Wow6432Node\Adroit Technologies". - From the Start menu, select Run …, type in REGEDIT and click OK. - Select HKEY_CURRENT_USER. - Create the following REG_ DWORD Value: HKEY_CURRENT_USER\Software\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Policies\System\DisableTaskMgr - Right-click this value, select Modify and change its value to 1. - This change will be immediately effective.

Title: EnvisaLinkTPI-1-08
Topic: 1.0 Overview 2
Question: How do I configure 1.0 Overview in Adroit SCADA?
Answer:
Envisalink's TPI will respond with the session status command, 505, and whether the password was accepted or rejected. If a password is not received within 10 seconds, the TPI will issue a 5052 command and close the TCP socket. The socket will also be closed if the password fails. Once the password is accepted, the session is created and will continue until the TCP connection is dropped. [Page 2] Note, as with all network communications, it is possible the TCP socket could be lost due to a network disruption, or an exception at either the client or server end.

Title: Mitsubishi MITAJE71
Topic: Troubleshooting
Question: How do I configure Troubleshooting in Adroit SCADA?

Title: Spectrum Tele-RANGER
Topic: configuration challenges
Question: How do I configure configuration challenges in Adroit SCADA?
Answer:
With PLC systems a read request is honoured immediately, whereas with a radio telemetry system, several different requests can be sent out before a response to the first one is received. Also, the sequence in which responses arrive is totally unpredictable Exception-based. Instead of using a poll-response type protocol like most other Adroit protocol drivers, the teleRanger driver operates in an exception- or event-based mode.
Category: Drivers
Document Type: driver

Title: About Agent Data (Slots)
Question: How do I use About Agent Data (Slots) (Smart Ui) in Adroit SCADA?
Answer:
There are clearly different types of data that need to be stored in an agent. This implies the concept of slot type , as well as agent type. An Adroit configuration is therefore made of many different agents, each of which is a unique instance of one of the supported agent types. Each agent, in turn, contains externally accessible data attributes, or slots, whose type corresponds to one of the supported slot types. Each agent (instance of an agent type) maintains its own unique set of data and is referred to by its own unique agent name. For details, see About Agents or Naming Agents .

Title: About Agents
Question: How do I use About Agents (Smart Ui) in Adroit SCADA?
Answer:
Agents are classified by function into a number of agent types, which can be used to implement a wide variety of system related, as well as application-specific tasks. For details, see About Agent Types . For example, the Analog agent type is used to handle the signal conditioning and alarm checking requirements of a process variable, and the DataLog agent type is responsible for creating, maintaining, and accessing historical data logs. The Agent Server is the storage facility for all agents. For details, see About Agent Servers .

Title: About Alarm Management
Question: How do I configure About Alarm Management (Smart Ui) in Adroit SCADA?
Answer:
Alarm management is concerned with improving the QUALITY of the information within the alarming configuration. In other words, alarm management can counteract inefficient alarming. This information should be used to reduce the QUANTITY of nuisance alarms (red herrings) so that only the most important and relevant alarms are displayed for your process. Note: By repeating this process regularly, you will be able to ensure that only relevant alarms are generated thereby improving your alarming system.

Title: Agent Subscriptions
Question: What are the key specifications or limits for Agent Subscriptions (Smart Ui)?
Answer:
- The result is that the subscription mechanism is more responsive and less redundant so that only actual changes are sent and only when the change occurs. - Subscriptions are the basis of most communication within the Agent Server, and between the Server and the connected clients, (Operators for example) . The concept of a subscription is based on the principle of "listening" for updates from a specific Agent tag (or slot). - The process of subscribing is setting up the "listener", by registering with the underlying mechanism of the relevant agent tag.

Title: ARec Agent - Slot Details
Topic: Slot Name Type Function bit00
Question: What does Slot Name Type Function bit00 (Smart Ui) mean in Adroit SCADA?
Answer:
Slot Name Type Function bit00 - bit31 BOOLEAN The default slot names representing the I/O bits of the AREC agent. These default names are replaced by the IDs of each state definition. coldStartEnable BOOLEAN Enables the cold start value. coldStartValue INTEGER A 32 bit mask representing the initial status of the I/O points. enable BOOLEAN Enables the state computer to set/clear the output bits. numOutputs INTEGER A number (1-32) indicating how many I/O points, starting at tag1 are designated as outputs. numSequences INTEGER Number of sequence steps to be defined, default 0.

Title: Basic Principles of DbAccess Agents
Question: How do I use Basic Principles of DbAccess Agents (Smart Ui) in Adroit SCADA?
Answer:
Each DbAccess Agent represents a transaction on a row, in a table, in a database. Before any transactions can take place, a connection to a database has to be established and a table in this database has to be identified, that requires or contains the information necessary for a transaction. IMPORTANT: If you are connecting to a database across the network and your Agent Server is running as a service, then ensure that the user profile that the Agent Server service uses to log onto the computer HAS the necessary rights to browse the network and connect to the remote database.

Title: Common Status Bits of the Multistate Agent
Question: What are the key specifications or limits for Common Status Bits of the Multistate Agent (Smart Ui)?
Answer:
If the MultiState agent goes into an unspecified state (i.e. a combination of inputs which has not been defined), it will be reported as being in State00 and will set the AGENT BAD bit and consequently the BAD bit will be set also. A new MultiState agent that has not been configured and has therefore never known anything except the invalid state will not have its BAD bits set.

Steps: Note: Be aware that if the agent is not enabled, this slot will always be set on [1]. Failed Also known as StatusBit21 This slot will be set on [1] if the last transaction failed. - Will be reset immediately prior to a transaction being executed. FailPulse Also known as StatusBit19 A short pulse is generated on a transaction failure. - This slot will be set on [1] for a very short period (approximately 100 ms) , if the last transaction failed. Succeeded Also known as StatusBit20 This slot will be set on [1] if the last transaction succeeded.

Title: How to use the ICMP agent to ensure the availability of a networked device
Topic: In the SmartUI Designer:
Question: How do I use In the SmartUI Designer: (Smart Ui) in Adroit SCADA?
Answer:
- The STRING pingStatus slot provides a textual description of the status of the last ICMP message used to contact the device, as follows: OK from [IP Address] if it succeeded; Retries exhausted when retrying to contact the device (a timeout failure) and Host unreachable from [IP Address] if it is not possible to contact the device. - The BOOLEAN pingNow slot performs an immediate ping. Note: If the specified timeout is too short then you will never get a "host unreachable" error because the network will not have the necessary time to respond.

This OLE Server Interface Specification forms the standard API (Application Programming Interface) for Agent Servers. Title: OPC Definitions
Topic: Top - OPC is short for OLE (Object linking embedding) for Process Control, it is a software technology designed, like OLE to allow different applications to exchange data, more specifically allowing an I/O server developed by a 3rd party to communicate to any SCADA. This allows a SCADA Supervisory Control And Data Acquisition, used to monitor and control an industrial plant or process and its related equipment. such as Adroit to use the same I/O server as any other SCADA, eliminating the need for each SCADA to have its own drivers or I/O server for a device. The technology allows for an OPC item ( scan point a scan point licence that is consumed from your Adroit license when information is being manipulated. ) to be read by a SCADA and, if enabled to do so, to also write to the OPC item. - An OPC Item

Title: SIMPDRV - Adroit Simulation Protocol Driver
Topic: Automatically Incrementing Scanned SIMPLC Values:
Question: How do I use Automatically Incrementing Scanned SIMPLC Values: (Smart Ui) in Adroit SCADA?
Answer:
To simulate a dynamic situation, the values in memory are automatically incremented, for every scan, by the DB number. The formula is: newvalue = oldvalue + DBnumber In other words, DB 0 will NEVER increment, and if DB100:DW### is scanned, the value will be incremented by 100 each scan. For Digital tags, the value will TOGGLE.

Title: The Accumulator Agent
Topic: Operation
Question: How do I use Operation (Smart Ui) in Adroit SCADA?
Answer:
When the agent is first enabled, it works as follows: - If the intervalMode slot property is set to 4, a new period will commence immediately. - If the intervalMode slot property is set to 3, the period will commence immediately but will end at the next synchronised period. - At the end of every period, the value is saved as lastValue and the new value is calculated as inputValue minus startValue .

Title: The Accumulator Agent
Topic: Trigger event
Question: How do I use Trigger event (Smart Ui) in Adroit SCADA?
Answer:
When a occurs: - The agent subtracts the previous interval input value from the current input value to determine the value differential for the current period. - This results in a value which represents "the total production for the last hour or shift or day and so-on" . - It then calculates the rate of change in value, which is the differential value for the current period divided by the interval of this period (value per hour) .

An alias is an assumed or "false" name of another agent.

When the agent is enabled, the agent will wait for one of three events to happen before performing a snapshot: - The occurrence of the next hourly period. - The very first period is synchronised to midnight, meaning that if you specify an hourly interval of 8, the first snapshot will occur at 08h00 or 16hoo or at 00h00, whichever occurs first. - After that, the snapshot will occur every subsequent 8 hours. - A manual snapshot can be requested via the dumpNow slot - A non-zero value trigger event of a selected trigger tag, when one is specified.

By continuously polling the specified remote IP address, this agent is therefore able to identify potential network problems as they occur by generating alarms when errors are obtained when attempting to contact the specified remote IP address and/or when the round trip time exceeds specified High and High-high times. Question: How do I use Networking: (Smart Ui) in Adroit SCADA?
Answer:
Use the PING command to determine if your clustered Agent Server computers are networked correctly. For instance, in the command prompt, type the following: ping -l 64000 -t partnerServerComputerName If you have a low success rate (many packets being lost or a high round trip time), then your network is the problem, which requires input and action from your I.T. department.

Steps: Different versions of the product on the two machines. Title: Usage Guidelines for DbAccess Agents
Question: How do I use Usage Guidelines for DbAccess Agents (Smart Ui) in Adroit SCADA?
Answer:
The DbAccess agents have the added functionality of retrieving data from OLE DB Servers. These agents require careful consideration in terms of both the number of agents to be used and the amount of work that they are to do, as they are resource "hungry". Hence, both the Agent Server memory and overall memory usage should be monitored during configuration to avoid the excessive usage of these resources. The CPU usage should be monitored while during operation to ensure that the computer is able to handle the additional load.

Title: Using Analog Agent Alarm Limits

Question: What are the key specifications or limits for Limitations (Smart Ui)?
Answer:
- The Low (the lo slot) and High (the hi slot) inner alarm limits are the first warning that a process value has moved outside its acceptable range, and implies that corrective action must be taken as soon as possible. - The Low-low (the loLo slot) and High-high (the hiHi slot) outer alarms are the second warning that the process value has moved further from its acceptable range and reached the second alarm limit.

Title: ACK Commands
Question: What are the key specifications or limits for ACK Commands (Smart Ui)?
Answer:
Where ' tag ' is the name of the agent a user wants to acknowledge, '[.alarm type]' is optional and allows you to to acknowledge a specific alarm for the specified agent. For instance "ANA_1.High" only acknowledges ANA_1.High, whereas "ANA_1" acknowledges ALL the alarms relating to the agent ANA_1. To globally acknowledge more than one alarm at a time, use the following format in this globalAck slot: tag[.alarm type],…, tag[.alarm type]. To acknowledge more than one alarm at a time, use the following format: ack,tag[.alarm type],…, tag[.

Title: AcknowledgeAtStartup
Question: How do I configure AcknowledgeAtStartup (Smart Ui) in Adroit SCADA?
Answer:
This registry value, if set to 1, forces the Agent Server to automatically acknowledge alarms at startup. WARNING: We do NOT RECOMMEND that you set this registry value to 0, otherwise you will be left with unacknowledged alarms as saved in the WGP file which could have occurred a long time ago and, if so, will no longer be relevant.

Title: Alarm Types
Question: How do I configure Alarm Types (Smart Ui) in Adroit SCADA?
Answer:
An alarm is triggered when one or more of the status mask bits in an alarm type of an Alarm agent matches any status bits in the agent being monitored. Agent Types may take the form of a descriptive abbreviation, e.g. "Overheating" for Analog agent types, or "Tripped" for Digital agent types. For an agent to be monitored, you have to apply one or more to the agent (see Alarming an Agent ). Each Alarm Type must be edited to define the alarm triggers that take the form of a descriptive abbreviation, e.g. "Overheating" for Analog agent types, or "Tripped" for Digital agent types.

Title: Alarming strategy
Topic: About Alarming Strategies
Question: How do I troubleshoot About Alarming Strategies (Smart Ui) in Adroit SCADA?
Answer:
Steps: Filtering of Alarms: An alarm priority can be specified for each agent, so that alarm agents can filter out all the alarms generated by low priority agents, if necessary. However, since this alarm priority is tag-specific rather than alarm-specific, it cannot be used as an efficient alarm filtering mechanism, for instance if we only want to display a sub-set of the alarms configured for an agent. The only mechanism in Adroit that can achieve this is to use an Alarm list as a destination and use the alarm viewer filtering mechanism.

Title: Automatic WGP File Backups
Question: What are the key specifications or limits for Automatic WGP File Backups (Smart Ui)?
Answer:
Note1: These backup files will be created in the folder in which the WGP file resides, EACH time it is saved, regardless as to whether its contents have been changed or not. Note2: Restoring these saved WGP files is still a manual process, which requires: stopping the Agent Server, renaming the WGP file that is currently being used; locating and renaming the required backup file to this name and restarting the Agent Server. The names of these automatically created backup copies, adhere to the following format: name.yyyymmdd_hhmmss_v_n.

Topic: Backing up and Server performance
Question: How do I troubleshoot Backing up and Server performance (Smart Ui) in Adroit SCADA?
Answer:
Normally backing up the Server data will not affect the performance of the Server, since this operation only briefly affects the CPU usage and the backup does not consume a large amount of the hard drive space. However, the larger the data files become, the more carefully one should configure the frequency of these backups.

Title: Default Alarm Management Queries
Question: What are the key specifications or limits for Default Alarm Management Queries (Smart Ui)?
Answer:
This is a measurement of alarm overload on operators, as follows: - Overloaded > 50% - Reactive 25%-50% - Stable 5%-25% - Robust 1%-5% - Predictive < 1%. Priority distribution: The priority distribution for incidents occurring over a period of time. Typically this should be 5% high priority alarms (>Normal priority), 15% medium priority alarms (=Normal priority) and 80% low priority alarms (<Normal priority). The 20 of these alarms can account for almost 50% of total alarm generation.

Title: PID Alarm Limits
Topic: Limitations
Question: What are the key specifications or limits for Limitations (Smart Ui)?
Answer:
Note: that whenever the LL alarm is on, the L alarm must by definition already be on. Similarly, whenever the HH alarm limit is reached, the H alarm limit will already have been passed. The alarm will not be cleared until the process value goes past the limit. When the value of the PValue or Error slot of the agent reaches one or more of these configured limits, the agent will set the relevant specific status bit . The PID agent type provides alarming capabilities for both the PV (process value) and the %Error or the percentage deviation of the PV from the SP (the required set-point).

Title: Adroit_Project_Path environmental variable
Question: What are the key specifications or limits for Adroit_Project_Path environmental variable (Smart Ui)?
Answer:
Adroit creates the "adroit_project_path" environment variable every time one of the following applications are started: PSEXE.exe, Adroit .exe and AS.exe, ASS.exe, BROWSER.exe and ADROPCSVR.exe. If necessary, you can reference this environment variable as follows: %adroit_project_path% This environment variable specifies the path, in the Program Data folder, of the currently selected configuration (such as: C:\ProgramData\Adroit Technologies\Adroit\Configurations\Default ).
Category: Smart UI - Configuration
Document Type: configuration

Title: Common Device Configuration
Topic: Primary and secondary parameters
Question: How do I troubleshoot Primary and secondary parameters (Smart Ui) in Adroit SCADA?
Answer:
Each device contains that define the available connection channels (or routes) and parameters. The secondary information is optional and is used in the event of a failure on the primary connection, or vice versa. How this secondary port works is simple, if the driver is using the primary configuration parameters and the communication fails, the driver will switch over to (and re-initialise) the secondary port and continue communicating via it if possible.

Title: Connecting the Portal Web Service to a remote Server
Topic: To connect the Web service to a remote Server computer:
Question: How do I configure To connect the Web service to a remote Server computer: (Smart Ui) in Adroit SCADA?
Answer:
Steps: Navigate to the SmartUI Web Service installation folder, which is typically: C:\Program Files\Adroit Technologies\Adroit\SmartUI\Webservice . - Locate the "Web.config" file in this folder and open it in a text editor, such as Notepad. Its first four lines should appear as follows: <?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8" ?> <configuration> <appSettings> <add key="server" value="localhost" /> - Modify the "localhost", so that the value refers to either the network name of the remote Server computer or its IP address. - Save this file and close it. .

Question: How do I troubleshoot Phase Actions and Tag/Value of a Master Recipe (Smart Ui) in Adroit SCADA?
Answer:
Steps: A VARIABLE action will alter recipe execution based on the value of the agent.slot given in the Tag/Value field, as follows: Slot value Action 0 Wait until the slot value changes to a value between 1 and 6 and then perform the action associated with this number 1 Go to next step 2 Go to previous step 3 Go to first step 4 Go to last step 5 Perform verification failure rollback 6 Stop recipe execution Note: the Tag/Value for a VARIABLE action is usually an expression or a slot that returns a Boolean value. The Tag/Value field may also be an explicit number between 0 and 6.

Title: The Configuration SystemInformation Page
Topic: Parameters on startup
Question: What are the key specifications or limits for Parameters on startup (Smart Ui)?
Answer:
These parameters should be configured in Adroit Setup (Config) BEFORE the Agent Server is started. - startMaxChannels : This specifies the maximum number channels used by this Agent Server. The default setting is 20. - startGranularity : This specifies the time granularity used by the Agent Server, which is the time interval, in seconds, that this SystemInformation agent updates itself. - startProject : This specifies the current project name of this Agent Server. This project name must not be longer than 8 characters, nor contain any embedded spaces.

Question: What are the key specifications or limits for adjust the default thresholds of the monitored processes (Smart Ui)?
Answer:
The configuration file is called HealthMonitorConfig.xml In this file, each specified executable allows you to specify the following thresholds, which specify the normal usage values, which if they are consistently exceeded indicates that there may be a problem and hence the Health Monitor Service will log messages in these instances: - CPUCoreThresholdPercent : This specifies the maximum percentage of the CPU that this process executable should consistently use in normal operation, above which the Health Monitor Service will provide alerts.

Title: Working with the Health Monitor Service
Topic: What does it do?
Question: How do I use What does it do? (Smart Ui) in Adroit SCADA?
Answer:
The following CPU usages are checked for each process: - If the CPU % is higher than 50% of 1 CPU Core it gets flagged for higher resolution monitoring. - If the Memory (Private Bytes) is more than 80% of 1146880000 bytes it gets flagged for higher resolution monitoring. When a Process has been flagged for higher resolution monitoring, then it is checked every 10 seconds: - If the process is still above the thresholds, an event entry is written to the Eventlog indicating the Process ID, Name, Description, Running Time, CPU Usage, Private Bytes & Virtual Bytes.

This registry value, if set to 1, this disables: - all the automatic validity checking of alarm values against engineering range that usually occur within the Analog agent, so that its alarm limits can be communicated and therefore configured externally, such as from a front-end device. Title: Data Logging Compression Methods
Question: What are the key specifications or limits for Data Logging Compression Methods (Smart Ui)?
Answer:
Logging values is an event-based function, by default, a value is logged whenever it changes. When logging values, you can specify both a time and value deadband (in the Datalog agent) to reduce the number of records that you log for a value which effectively 'compresses' your log files so you are able to store more data on the same storage medium. - Using the Value deadband: Values are ONLY logged if their change in value EXCEEDS the specified deadband value. Hence when the value of a logged point does not exceed the previously logged value by more than the deadband, the value is not logged.
Category: Smart UI - Logging
Document Type: help

Title: Active Clusters Foundation
Topic: Clustering Agent Servers
Question: How do I configure Clustering Agent Servers (Smart Ui) in Adroit SCADA?
Answer:
Clustered Agent Servers, previously known as hot standby, provide both client and server redundancy enabling high availability of the system. For more details on addressing the important issues that affect the operation and configuration of clustered Adroit Agent Servers, see Important Points to consider when . The general idea of clustering is that the master server services all the I/O and client tasks, while the standby server replicates the master server. There are three key mechanisms in Active Clusters namely catch-up , replication and switchover .

Title: Alternate Secondary Port Enabled
Question: How do I use Alternate Secondary Port Enabled (Smart Ui) in Adroit SCADA?
Answer:
Using the same PC port / resource, but different PLC ports / resources. Adroit drivers can make use of a different PLC addressing to cater for the possible failure of some communications hardware component. For this to be effective, the PLCs used need to have separate addresses and both PLCs need to be able to be independently accessed by the Adroit drivers. If the retries are exhausted and there is still no valid response, the Adroit driver will use the secondary PLC address, if it is configured when this step is reached.

Title: Automatic master mode assignment
Topic: An automatic election for master mode at a healthy standby server will occur when:
Question: How do I use An automatic election for master mode at a healthy standby server will occur when: (Smart Ui) in Adroit SCADA?
Answer:
- a healthy master server is removed - when the current healthy master server becomes unhealthy - the user sets the serverMode slot of a healthy standby server to master or - the user sets the serverMode slot of a master server to standby. This results in a new master and the Adroit system will ensure that the existing master is relegated to standby, thereby ensuring that two master servers cannot exist in the cluster.

Title: Basic principles of server mode assignment strategies in Adroit
Question: What are the key specifications or limits for Basic principles of server mode assignment strategies in Adroit (Smart Ui)?
Answer:
The state of a cluster server is recorded in the systeminfo.serverMode (0, 1, 2 = master, standby, normal respectively) and systeminfo.serverState (0, 1 = unhealthy, healthy respectively) slots for every cluster server. A new cluster server always starts up as a standby server. The serverstate slot always starts up as healthy and remains as such unless the user changes it to unhealthy (0) via a script, expression agent or a similar means.

Title: Best Practices
Topic: Project Directory Structure
Question: How do I configure Project Directory Structure (Smart Ui) in Adroit SCADA?
Answer:
The Adroit Software should be separated from the configured project(s), since this allows for easier backups, upgrades etc. For this reason, a directory for Adroit projects should be created at the root drive (or wherever the data files are required to be stored), typically called ' C:\ProgramData\Adroit Technologies\Adroit\Configurations\Default ', this project folder should contain the following directories: - \CSV, which should contain all your exported data. - \CustomAgents, which contains all the custom agents created for the project.

Title: Browsing for data translation keys
Topic: Wildcard agent notation:
Question: What are the key specifications or limits for Wildcard agent notation: (Smart Ui)?
Answer:
You can specify the following wildcard notation: AdroitDatasourceName.TagName.*.slot to return all agents that contain this slot. For instance: Adroit.Analog.*.agentDescription Note1: If a slot is a number or a date/time value then this is not added, since this value cannot be translated. Note2: A warning is displayed if this operation involves more than 10 000 slots.

Title: Catch-up
Question: How do I use Catch-up (Smart Ui) in Adroit SCADA?
Answer:
When a new server is added to the cluster, it must become a mirror image of the active member of the cluster. The new server must restore its historical data (historical ) that it lost during the down time. This historical synchronization or Datalog is facilitated by a new agent called the SystemDatalog agent .

Title: Creating the Requests collection
Question: How do I configure Creating the Requests collection (Smart Ui) in Adroit SCADA?
Answer:
One of the objects exposed by the Data Object is the Requests collection, a collection of individual descriptions for required real-time data. The slot names are gathered into another collection called the Properties collection. Since the Data Object provides the Requests collection as one of its properties, the VBA code to gain access to the Requests collection is simply: Set reqs = dataObj.Requests A single request consists of the tag plus the names of all slots to be monitored.

Title: Demand Scanning
Topic: What is demand scanning and how should it be used?
Question: What are the key specifications or limits for demand scanning and how should it be used? (Smart Ui)?
Answer:
Note: There is a fair amount of overhead involved for each demand scanned process value, since the NASA driver has to constantly query the Agent Server to determine when this process value is being used. Therefore due to this implicit overhead only configure process values to be demand scanned that will benefit from , in other words, do not configure process values for that will NEVER make use of this mechanism (e.g. those that are logged or alarmed).

Title: Finding spiders
Question: What are the key specifications or limits for Finding spiders (Smart Ui)?
Answer:

PLEASE NOTE: When Data Execution Prevention (DEP) is incorrectly configured, this can cause the Agent Server to be unable to read the HASP, at start up causing the Agent Server to hang or fail and/or to display HASP exceptions in the Agent Server window. Title: Historical Data Catch Up of the Newly Added Standby Server
Question: How do I use Historical Data Catch Up of the Newly Added Standby Server (Smart Ui) in Adroit SCADA?
Answer:
When a standby server joins a cluster, the historical data stored on the master server must be mirrored over to the standby server. This is done in an intelligent manner by only copying over the data that it requires, that is, the data stored by the master during the period that the newly added standby server was down.

Title: How MAPS implements the S88 / S95 hierarchy
Question: How do I use How MAPS implements the S88 / S95 hierarchy (Smart Ui) in Adroit SCADA?
Answer:
- The Site level is the MAPS project. So you will have one MAPS project per site. For example, XYZ Foods. - The Area level is the defined Plant area/s of the MAPS project. For example, Batching Plant. - The Process Cell level is the PLC/s of each defined plant area. For example, BATCHING PLC. - The Unit level is the collection/s of equipment items within each PLC. - The Equipment module and the Control module levels are NOT separately implemented because this is not supported by the PLC programming architecture.

Title: How to cluster Servers
Topic: Notes
Question: How do I configure How to cluster Servers (Smart Ui) in Adroit SCADA?
Answer:
A ping interval between 5 and 10 seconds should suffice for most cluster configurations. This is configured by the ClientPingInterval setting of the SmartUI Operator, which is grouped under the ConnectionSettings in the SmartUI Operator.exe.config file. The ClientPingInterval setting determines how often the SmartUI Operator will query the Server for an active connection and its configuration has the following effect upon the performance of the Operator: - If this interval is too frequent interval, this will increase client-server chatter and use up bandwidth unnecessarily.

Topic: Subscribe-Poll
Question: How do I use Subscribe-Poll (Smart Ui) in Adroit SCADA?
Answer:
- A communications mechanism that can be used on a LAN/WAN or the Internet. - This mechanism does NOT PUSH any data to the CLIENT, but relies on the CLIENT to POLL for the data. - ALL the changes since the last POLL cycle will be retrieved from the SERVER. - This mechanism attempts to reduce latency by minimising round-trips to the SERVER.

Title: Manual Master Mode Assignment
Topic: Rules and implications
Question: What are the key specifications or limits for Rules and implications (Smart Ui)?
Answer:
- There cannot be more than one master server in a cluster. Hence making a server master will immediately switch the other server to standby mode. - The serverMode and serverState slots between Agent Servers and within an Agent Server are not replicated. - All other server and client clustering operations will operate as normal given the slot values, irrespective of whether a manual or automatic master mode assignment method is used.
Category: Smart UI - Other

Title: Manual Master Mode Assignment
Topic: Suggested method of operation
Question: How do I use Suggested method of operation (Smart Ui) in Adroit SCADA?
Answer:
As suggested in the above scenarios, start all or part of the cluster servers. Set the desired master server as master through the various means available to set the serverMode slot (one way would be to use the dialog in the options-preferences-connection menu item). The automatically assigned clients switch their connection to the new master server. Start both Agent Servers in the cluster at the same time, and then the server with the lowest alphabetical name (i.e. closest to 'a') will become the master server.

Title: MarkBadIfWriteFails
Question: How do I configure MarkBadIfWriteFails (Smart Ui) in Adroit SCADA?
Answer:
If you have devices that do not allow writes to certain registers (which causes agents to be scan bad when a write fails) then add the following value and set it to 0, so that the next read will simply overwrite the value that the user wanted to write in the first place: HKEY_LOCAL_MACHINE\SOFTWARE\Adroit Technologies\Adroit\Scanning\ (REG_)DWORD = 0 to force Adroit to not mark values bad when their write fails.

Title: MarkBadOnStartup
Question: How do I troubleshoot MarkBadOnStartup (Smart Ui) in Adroit SCADA?
Answer:
Since the Agent Server does not poll values at startup, you can add the following value and set it to 0 to mark your values healthy on startup and display the values that were last saved in the WGP file: HKEY_LOCAL_MACHINE\SOFTWARE\Adroit Technologies\Adroit\Scanning\ (REG_)DWORD = 0, the default value is 1, which marks values bad on startup as is the default Adroit behaviour.

Title: Master Recipe
Question: How do I configure Master Recipe (Smart Ui) in Adroit SCADA?
Answer:
The following are the components of the : - Step: Both master and control recipes consist of sequences of steps. The consists of all the process variables or "ingredients" and the sequence in which they are to be downloaded. It is here that the procedure and associated tag names will be defined. Each step is numbered, and if any new steps are inserted or deleted, the steps are renumbered consecutively. The keyword <NONE> when used as an ingredient indicates that no process variable will change for the step. This allows a phase action to take place without having to set any process variable.

Title: MultiState Data Model
Question: What are the key specifications or limits for MultiState Data Model (Smart Ui)?
Answer:
This approach, namely having a separate bit dedicated to each state, leads to a smooth integration with the Classic user interface multicolor Behaviour, by allowing a different text, line and/or background color for each discrete state. In addition, these bits can be individually alarmed using existing Adroit alarming mechanisms, which means a wide variety of alarm strategies can be developed. These inputs can originate from any Boolean, Integer, or Real data, but will be converted to Boolean TRUE/FALSE indications on being stored in a MultiState agent.

Title: MultiState Operation
Question: How do I use MultiState Operation (Smart Ui) in Adroit SCADA?
Answer:
On reaching a new state, a MultiState agent automatically carries out the following actions: - The new state is recorded as the current state. - The new state's description is recorded as the current state description. - Any outputs in the new state's output-true list are set TRUE. - Any outputs in the new state's output-false list are set FALSE.

Title: Poke ActiveX Method
Question: How do I use Poke ActiveX Method (Smart Ui) in Adroit SCADA?
Answer:
Method Poke(Agent, Slot : string; Value : variant) : boolean; This method changes the value of a tag. Agent Functionality . Parameters: - Agent: The name of the agent or tag (agent.slot) whose value is to be changed. - Slot: the name of the slot whose value is to be changed. Title: Replication
Question: What are the key specifications or limits for Replication (Smart Ui)?
Answer:
All these sources of change are replicated to all Agent Servers in the cluster in order to maintain the mirror image state of the clustered servers. Two instances of configuring within a cluster are: - Client Runtime Transaction Shadowing : All transactions initiated by a client on a server are shadowed to the other server in the cluster to provide total data . - Parallel scanning : Each cluster server is configured to replicate the scanning tasks to provide scan task , that is, each server performs scanning as if it were a normal server.

Title: Route List CSV File Format
Question: How do I configure Route List CSV File Format (Smart Ui) in Adroit SCADA?
Answer:
This file is created when an Alarm agent is exported to store its alarm routes that have been configured. The filename adheres to the following naming convention: xxxxx- ROUTLST.CSV, where xxxxx represents the name of this Alarm agent. This file consists of the following columns, from left to right: - Alarm-list: The name of the alarm-list agent (multiple list-agents are separated by spaces). - Route number: The route number. - Audio device: The tag.slot name of the agent(s) used to sound the alarms of this alarm route.

Title: Routing to Audio Devices
Question: What are the key specifications or limits for Routing to Audio Devices (Smart Ui)?
Answer:
Routing an alarm to an audio device has the effect of incrementing or decrementing the specified slot that must be of type boolean or integer. New alarms cause the slot value to be incremented, and acknowledgment of these alarms will cause the value to be decremented. If the start slot of the Beeper agent is used, it will activate a repetitive beeping sound in the PC speaker. The sound pitch will become higher each time the start slot is incremented by a new alarm, and will be lowered when an alarm is acknowledged and the slot decremented.

Also the FetchChanges & FetchValues functions of the Adroit ActiveX component also consume scan point licenses for the same reason. - Any tag (agent.slot) writes from the Adroit OPC Server will consume one scan point license per unique tag. - Once a Command agent has been allowed to perform commands, scan point licenses are consumed by every unique phone number specified by this agent and/or used to send SMS messages to it.

Title: Secondary Port Disabled
Question: How do I troubleshoot Secondary Port Disabled (Smart Ui) in Adroit SCADA?
Answer:
A device goes into recovery whenever a Read or Write transaction fails. This failure is a 3 step process: - Adroit requests an update from the front-end device. - Timeout Phase: the request is sent to the front end device, and times out or gives an invalid response. - Retry Phase: Step 2 is repeated for the number of retries configured.
Category: Smart UI - Other
Document Type: help
Section Type: procedural
Keywords: adroit scada, adroit, port, troubleshoot, scada, failure, timeout, retry, smart, other, secondary, disabled

Title: Secondary Port Enabled
Question: How do I troubleshoot Secondary Port Enabled (Smart Ui) in Adroit SCADA?
Answer:
Adroit drivers can make use of a secondary port to cater for the possible failure of some communications hardware component. For this to be effective, the hardware used by the secondary port should be totally separate (e.g. extra serial card and cable). A device goes into recovery whenever a Read or Write transaction fails. If the retries are exhausted and there is still no valid response, the Adroit driver will use the secondary port if it is configured when this step is reached. This involves a port switchover, and only occurs once in any transaction.
Category: Smart UI - Other
Document Type: help
Section Type: procedural

Answer:
This is a minimalistic standard of user interface design, which has come about through years of research and trial and error. This standard moves away from the brightly colored and the almost photo-realistic process design of the past which used bright colors that while at the outset were visually appealing, proved in practice to only distract the operators from the process they were monitoring. Consistent alarm indication : the applicable situation awareness wizards use the same numbers and colors and graphical symbols to indicate your alarms.

Topic: Using Shadowed Cluster Servers with Drivers
Question: How do I configure Using Shadowed Cluster Servers with Drivers (Smart Ui) in Adroit SCADA?
Answer:
Note: Asynchronous or non-polling exception-based (telemetry) drivers are particularly affected by shadowed cluster servers. When a second cluster partner, is started, it will start in standby mode and then any Classic UIs configured to attach to this newly started server will display any tags that are linked to "telemetry" device(s) as being "greyed-out" or marked bad. Note: Normally, this should only be a problem on the UI of an unmanned cluster node, which is configured to connect locally, since all other remote UIs should be tracking the master.

Title: Time Stamping
Question: How do I use Time Stamping (Smart Ui) in Adroit SCADA?
Answer:
Scanned values get their timestamp from the data packet returned by the front-end device, if the protocol driver is exception based and implements a time-stamping protocol. A time stamp may also be created in an agent when a user enters a value manually. The time is taken from the systemInformation agent, which in turns gets it from the system clock. When the agent subsequently sends a subscription update to another agent, or picture element Behaviour, the same timestamp value is passed on.

Title: Time Synchronization of an Adroit Cluster
Topic: Time Synchronization
Question: How do I troubleshoot Time Synchronization (Smart Ui) in Adroit SCADA?
Answer:
Steps: The Trend displays odd Behaviour: either the data seems to be inserted into the middle of the trend, or a strange unexplainable sudden change in the values being trended when pressing F5 to refresh the trend. - The data logs of the two unsynchronised Agent Servers in a cluster seem to get corrupted (as a result of the data being inserted into the wrong place) after doing a Datalog catch-up with the SystemDatalog agent. This corruption is most notable in a trend.

Title: Title 21 CFR Part 11 Compliance
Question: How do I use Title 21 CFR Part 11 Compliance (Smart Ui) in Adroit SCADA?
Answer:
Title 21 CFR Part 11 (21 CFR 11) of the Code of Federal Regulations deals with the United States Food and Drug Administration (FDA) guidelines on electronic records and electronic signatures (ERES). This defines the criteria and circumstances under which electronic records and electronic signatures are considered to be trustworthy, reliable and equivalent to paper records by the FDA.

Click for more details: In this case, when the graphic form is opened that contains or references this process value, then the NASA driver will become aware that this graphic form requires this process value and so it will communicate (scan) this value from its front-end device. Title: Understanding the NASA drivers and their new features
Topic: Improved multi-channel performance
Question: What are the key specifications or limits for Improved multi-channel performance (Smart Ui)?
Answer:
Previously, only specific legacy drivers supported multi channels, such as Modbus EMC or Modbus Radio. All NASA drivers provide support for multi channels although this feature is off by default. When enabled, NASA drivers can support up to 8 channels, which are utilised as-needed to service the required transactions to achieve parallel communication on a single device.

Title: Understanding the NASA drivers and their new features
Topic: Optimised scan tasks
Question: How do I use Optimised scan tasks (Smart Ui) in Adroit SCADA?
Answer:
Typically when scanning process values to and from Adroit, the legacy drivers would create separate scan jobs for different: - Agent types, such as: Analog, Digital, Integer, String, Marshal and Multistate and their - Data type formats, such as: longs, words and dwords. This would therefore increase the total number of scan jobs and therefore the overhead required to communicate your process values.

Title: Understanding the NASA drivers and their new features
Topic: Usage scenarios NOT recommended for demand scanning:
Question: How do I troubleshoot Usage scenarios NOT recommended for demand scanning: (Smart Ui) in Adroit SCADA?
Answer:
Steps: Demand scanning cannot be used as a strategy to "reuse" your scan points, since as explained above a scanned point license is not relinquished by a demand scanned tag when its tag is not being scanned, since the NASA driver has to constantly query the Agent Server to determine when this process value is being used. - We do also NOT recommend the use of demand scanning for a clustered Agent Server that uses shadow scanning and a proxy server to handle requests for its tags from remote clients. Since this could return INCORRECT VALUEs.

Title: Using the color Palette
Topic: Selecting colors
Question: What are the key specifications or limits for Selecting colors (Smart Ui)?
Answer:

Title: Value formatting syntax
Question: How do I use Value formatting syntax (Smart Ui) in Adroit SCADA?
Answer:
{0:e} = 1.420000e+000 {1:E3} = -1.240E+004 F or f Fixed point The resultant string is of the form "-ddd.ddd..." where each 'd' indicates a digit (0-9). The string starts with a minus sign if the number is negative. Note: If the precision specifier is omitted, the default numeric precision is used. {0:f4} = 1.4200 {1:F} = -12400.00 G or g General The number is converted to the most compact of either fixed-point or scientific notation, depending on the type of the number and whether a precision specifier is present.

Title: What is maximum demand and why should you monitor it?
Question: What are the key specifications or limits for maximum demand and why should you monitor it? (Smart Ui)?
Answer:
Maximum demand is an additional cost for most non-domestic power users. Your maximum demand limit is the maximum amount of electricity that you are allowed to use to run your process during peak demand times, which in South Africa is measured in kVAh. It is the method used by your electricity provider to control how much electricity you use, especially at peak times, when your usage coincides with peak domestic usage. Consequently monitoring your maximum demand can result in considerable savings and reduced power usage.
Category: Smart UI - Other
Document Type: help
Section Type: spec

Title: Working with 21 CFR 11 mode
Topic: Requirements
Question: What are the key specifications or limits for Requirements (Smart Ui)?
Answer:
The configuration (.config) files on the SmartUI Server computer must be made inaccessible (through directory and file level security) to prevent unauthorised users from: - disabling the 21 CFR 11 setting thereby "turning off" the audit mechanism entirely and the use of the secure connection to the Adroit Agent Server and - deleting the mandatory local secure SQL Server Compact database that stores the 21 CFR 11 auditing.

Title: Working with 21 CFR 11 mode
Topic: What 21 CFR 11 mode enforces (design-restrictions):
Question: What are the key specifications or limits for What 21 CFR 11 mode enforces (design-restrictions): (Smart Ui)?
Answer:
21 CFR 11 compliance requires limiting system access to authorised individuals. Note: This means that one cannot use the Configurator to configure Adroit agents in the SmartUI Designer when using 21 CFR 11 mode - so all Agent Server configuration must occur in the Designer itself. Therefore the connection to the Adroit Agent Server is now secured to limit exactly which client connection to it is allowed to prevent unsanctioned access (from Classic or legacy Adroit Clients and third party applications).

Title: Working with connections
Topic: Connections are created are follows:
Question: What are the key specifications or limits for Connections are created are follows: (Smart Ui)?
Answer:
Each connection consists of the following mandatory properties, apart from the user login details: - Host Name: The network name or IP address of the Server computer that will be connected to. Note: If this Server uses a port other than 9000 (the default), this becomes: 'HostName:PortNumber'. - Type: The physical connection between this Client computer and the required Server computer i.e. via the LAN or the Internet. - Mode: The method of communicating data between the Client and Server computers, which depends upon the selected Type .

Title: Working with the Adtech Licensing Utility
Topic: Important differences between a HASP and a soft license:
Question: What are the key specifications or limits for Important differences between a HASP and a soft license: (Smart Ui)?
Answer:
Your product license can either be a HASP and a soft license, each of which have the following important differences: - A HASP license is bound to a USB HASP, which has a specific serial number - this is therefore portable and not restricted to a specific computer, but has associated security risks and needs to be insured at your own risk. - A Soft license is bound to a specific computer and therefore cannot be transferred to another computer.

Title: Factors affecting OEE or KPI calculations
Topic: Available time
Question: What are the key specifications or limits for Available time (Smart Ui)?
Answer:
Whereas KPI calculations are performed against runtime, OEE calculations are calculated against the time that the process/machine is available for production. The OEE agent therefore uses the BOOLEAN available slot (or the optional BOOLEAN tag reference availableTag ) to determine the maximum . - This slot should be ON when the machine/process is supposed to be running. - If the process/machine is under maintenance or operators are at lunch/tea, this slot should be OFF.

Title: Factors affecting OEE or KPI calculations
Topic: Calculation duration
Question: What are the key specifications or limits for Calculation duration (Smart Ui)?
Answer:
By default, the agent records the OEE or KPI based on shift numbers, which are determined by the Shift agent specified by the Shift tag field of the edit dialog ( shiftAgent slot). At the end of each shift the OEE or KPI is recorded and automatically reset for the start of the next shift. For details, see Configuring the Shift agent . If you want to use the agent for recording the OEE or KPI on a "per batch" basis, then: - Disable the autoReset slot of the agent (uncheck the Shift auto-reset checkbox of the edit dialog) and - Programmatically reset the agent at the end of every batch.

Title: Factors affecting OEE or KPI calculations
Topic: Complex mode and KPI calculation
Question: How do I use Complex mode and KPI calculation (Smart Ui) in Adroit SCADA?
Answer:
To allow for KPIs that have one measurement divided by another measurement (other than time), such as kWh/ton- the OEE agent supports a second measurement input slot ( input2 ). For normal OEE and KPI calculations, input2 is not used and the input type is set to Unused (0), by default. In this case: KPI% = (Total for the Shift for input1/Run time)/Target KPI If the Input type 2 field (the type2 slot) is NOT set to Unused (0), then the OEE agent is said to be in complex mode.

Title: Factors affecting OEE or KPI calculations
Topic: OEE calculations
Question: How do I use OEE calculations (Smart Ui) in Adroit SCADA?
Answer:
The OEE agent performs using the following formula: OEE% = Quality% * Performance% * Availability% Where: Quality% = Quality factor(%) * ((Total for the Shift - Reject Count)/Total for the Shift) Performance% = Total for the Shift/(Design capacity (per hour) * Run time) Availability (hours)% = Run time/Available time Availability Percent of scheduled production (to measure reliability) or calendar hours 24/7/365 (to measure equipment utilization), that equipment is available for production.

Title: Factors affecting OEE or KPI calculations
Topic: Quality factor
Question: How do I use Quality factor (Smart Ui) in Adroit SCADA?
Answer:
Quality can be calculated in many ways, depending on the type of process and the variables/information available to calculate quality. Therefore, the OEE agent calculates the quality using the reject and total counts for the shift, which is multiplied by an external , expressed as a percentage. This % value (the qualityFactor slot) is the external whose value (0 to 100) must be driven externally.

Title: Factors affecting OEE or KPI calculations
Topic: Running time
Question: How do I use Running time (Smart Ui) in Adroit SCADA?
Answer:
If the measurement variable (the input1 slot) remains inactive for a configurable amount of time then the OEE agent will stop incrementing the and will raise a downtime alarm status. Therefore the actual production time is determined by a combination of the running slot and an active input1 slot. This causes the measurement variable (the input1 slot) to remain static or go to zero i.e. inactive. KPI calculations are performed against runtime.

Title: Condition Bits (not directly modifiable by the user)
Question: How do I use Condition Bits (not directly modifiable by the user) (Smart Ui) in Adroit SCADA?
Answer:
Because the agent bit might have been set by the user or system - and we don't want to lose this information - all agent condition bit values are derived by combining slot condition bits with the agent condition bits. If an agent bit is therefore set before one of its slot bit are set, it would still remain set when all slot bits are reset. Condition Bits fan-in, which means that an agent condition bit is automatically set to 1 whenever one of the corresponding slot condition bits is set to 1. The converse, however, is not true, i.e.

Title: Control Bits (user modifiable)
Question: How do I use Control Bits (user modifiable) (Smart Ui) in Adroit SCADA?
Answer:
Control Bits fan-out, which means that a slot control bit becomes set or reset, whenever the corresponding agent control bit is set or reset. Note: Unlike Condition Bit fan-in, Control Bit fan-out does not use positive logic (nor negative logic, for that matter): when an agent bit is set or reset this action is performed on all its corresponding slot bits.

Question: How do I use Philosophy for End User Applications (Smart Ui) in Adroit SCADA?
Answer:
The general philosophy is for the user to create an instance of a coarse grained object, and then instruct the object to create many finer grained objects inside itself. A coarse grained object corresponds to a connection to a known Agent Server, either running on the same computer as the application, or some other computer on a local- or wide-area network.

Title: To install or uninstall the Agent Server as a service
Topic: How to set up To install or uninstall the Agent Server as a service
Question: How do I configure To install or uninstall the Agent Server as a service (Smart Ui) in Adroit SCADA?
Answer:
Typically the Agent Server is configured to run as a Service during the install, although you can do this after the install if necessary by using the following command line switches that the Agent Server process (as.exe) provides: - Press the Windows key + R shortcut to open the Run dialog. - Type in as.exe followed by following commands and press ENTER: /install /u:"[Domain\]Username" /p:"Password" /quiet This command will install the Agent Server as a service. The /quiet parameter suppresses any feedback messages. /uninstall This command will remove the Agent Server as a service.

Q: When writing to a register, the value does not change, why? Title: TroubleShooting an Intermittent Communication Problem
Topic: TroubleShooting Driver Communication Failure
Question: How do I troubleshoot TroubleShooting Driver Communication Failure (Smart Ui) in Adroit SCADA?
Answer:
Determine which request is causing the communication failure. If the driver fails once and then succeeds on the retry, then the fault lies within the PLC and that this is NOT an Adroit problem. Follow the steps below to trouble-shoot the location of the problem: - Backup your database (WGP file) - Unscan all the tags to that PLC. - Save and restart the Agent Server. - Gradually add the scanning back in (in very small groups) waiting about 30 seconds between each. Steps: Check that the scan-points, within the group that have just been added have actual addresses in the PLC.
Category: Smart UI - Troubleshooting
